records.issue_text: absolutize_urls mangles protocol-relative URLs by rewriting them to paths on the wrong host
records.rationale: In TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls, links/images are rewritten whenever href/src starts_with?('/'). records.issue_text: Non-atomic SETNX + EXPIRE in topic_retriever can permanently throttle an embed URL if the process dies between the two calls
records.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb#retrieved_recently?, throttling uses two separate Redis calls: `setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` followed by `expire(retrieved_key, 60)`. If the process/thread dies after the SETNX succeeds but before EXPIRE runs, the key will persist without a TTL, causing that `embed_url` to be considered "retrieved recently" indefinitely (permanent throttle).
